title: 12 Nov-Afternoon of Music, Warmth & Fellowship
summary: On 12 Nov, our Club under the leadership of Senior Citizens Committee Chairman Rtn. Dr. Arvind Kasbekar hosted a heartwarming musical for the residents of Sir J.J.
description:
On 12 Nov, our Club under the leadership of Senior Citizens Committee Chairman Rtn. Dr. Arvind Kasbekar hosted a heartwarming musical for the residents of Sir J.J. Dharamshala in Nagpada.
The event featured an enchanting live performance by vocalist Mr. Vijayraj, who captivated the audience with timeless Hindi classics.
Adding to the festive spirit, Club President Rtn. Bernhard Steinruecke—joined by Rtn. Dr. Arvind Kasbekar, P.P. Manoj Jalan, P.P. Anil Kamath, Rtn. Anupam Chaturvedi, Rtn. Geeta Parikh, R/Ann Dr. Vaibhavie Prasad Kasbekar, R/Ann Aarti Gautam, Inner Wheel Club P.P. Aarti Asha Singh, and Inner Wheel Club President Asha Bhatia—distributed fresh fruits along with hand and bath towels to the residents.
The celebrations culminated in a sumptuous festive lunch complete with traditional Diwali sweets, hosted by the club.
A truly memorable highlight was seeing President Bernhard Steinruecke and members share joyful moments dancing with elderly. Project cost Rs 25,000.
